task.title: Identify independent task Verification checks
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/771 with a validated caller-owned check identity persisted alongside every new structured Verification result.
acceptance_criteria: Expose the exact validated check identity to the verifier before any checker effects.
Persist check, outcome, evidence, fresh Verification identity, and exact parent Attempt atomically.
Fail closed on malformed identified payloads while preserving payload versions 1 through 3 without fabricated identities.
Keep check identity descriptive and unable to grant permissions or lifecycle authority.

attempts.summary: Established RED check-identity and replay coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: Runtime and replay tests failed because TaskVerificationCheck, request check access, payload version 4, and the identified append argument did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added exact verifier-input, passed/failed round-trip, blank-check, malformed-version-4, unknown-field, and historical compatibility tests.

attempts.diagnostic: A validated opaque identity was sufficient for later gate matching without encoding commands, permissions, or artifacts.
attempts.patch: Added TaskVerificationCheck, propagated it through the runtime request and typed append metadata, introduced strict payload version 4 replay, and documented the provenance-only boundary.

attempts.summary: Completed independent review without follow-up findings.
attempts.diagnostic: Read-only review found no blocking correctness, compatibility, or permission-boundary defect in the exact patch.
attempts.patch: Preserved the single reviewed commit and verified the complete repository in the pinned environment.

outcome.summary: New independent Verification evidence carries an exact validated caller-owned check identity, while historical evidence remains honest about missing identity and check names confer no execution authority.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test task_verification_runtime
nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test task_observations

lessons: Stable check identity should be opaque validated provenance, not an executable checker definition.
Schema evolution must preserve the absence of fields in historical evidence instead of inventing defaults.
Strict versioned replay can reject malformed new records without breaking valid older payloads.
